summary: Lexeo Therapeutics filed an 8-K on June 15, 2026 to disclose regulatory updates for its LX2006 gene therapy and post an updated corporate presentation. The filing does not involve a merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, or any special-situation event. It is a routine disclosure of a press release and investor presentation, with no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. Accordingly, it does not qualify as a special situation.
